prior_opinion_exposure: I authored initial36-37 candidates, received independent36:4 object correction and parent request, and have read final input; this is author review, not independent or blind.

reviews.rationale: Printed75 complete36:1 matches source including starred three and daggered corrupt south in weather list. English retains that crux literally; note accurately distinguishes Charles’s moisture and marginal-gloss conjectures from printed wording. No silent lexical emendation.

Both beginning at foot of printed75 and continuation at top76 included. East, heaven-end, three open portals and smaller portals above all accounted for. Exact unit now replaces former whole-chapter oracle source; no36:1/3 material included.
Printed76 unit3 fully matched; numeral each-one, stars passing, western direction, shown path all represented. Isolated ink comparison confirms starred ምዕራበ west, not east. No source fragment lost.

Printed76 fullunit and critical marks matched. Fresh ተግባሮ reading confirmed. Final English correctly makes ግብሮ and ተግባሮ accusative objects of praise rather than subjects; angels/spirits/humankind remain agents. The entire power/hands/blessing conclusion retained. Note accurately describes reported spirits/people variant without manuscript-independence claim.

Printed76 entire repeated vision/saw heading and all genealogical links matched. English retains rather than deletes heading repetition and properly qualifies second/another alternative and apparatus omissions.

Printed76 source glyphs match including fresh የኃድሩ, bracketed [እብል] and final መንፈሳት. Bracketed dittography excluded from duplicate English speaking clause and disclosed. Former/latter contrast, holy words and presence of Lord of Spirits accounted for.

Printed76 source and lexical grammar checked: better/to-speak/not-withhold retained, not substituted with parable/another. Suspended nominative this-former grouping is disclosed. Full negative final wisdom clause matches.

Printed76-77 continuation complete: negative opening, received wisdom, both as clauses, divine will and share of eternal life retained. All two title occurrences visibly print መንፈሳት. Until-now with had-not-been-given and current received wisdom is a defensible conservative temporal construction; difficult syntax and alternative which-for-negative are explicitly disclosed. No unattested greater-than comparison installed. Earlier author caution was not evidence of an untranslatable clause; this bounded qualified rendering is acceptable without claiming original syntax certainty.

Printed77 full finalunit matched through beforeXXXVIII. Fresh ወአነ and አንሣእኩ confirmed, not OCR corruption. Three parables, first-person taking-up and dwelling audience represented; came-to-me is reasonably contextual and literal with-me alternative is disclosed.

approval_scope: Exact submitted source/English/notes bytes of selected critical edition only; not independent manuscript attestation, human-specialist certification or artwork/publication QA.
